description: Finta syncs financial data from banks, investment accounts, and Stripe into productivity tools such as Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Coda. It stores synced account, transaction, balance, and holdings data so users can query and manage it from apps and AI tools.
summary: Finta exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a Bearer-token REST API at https://api.finta.io/v2 with an OpenAPI spec, and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at https://mcp.finta.io/mcp using streamable HTTP.
